fields.label: Role in team
fields.description: A Team Lead sees the team's conversations and everything below it; an Agent sees only their own.

fields.label: Max open
fields.description: Most open conversations at once. 0 uses the number's default.

fields.label: Rep code
fields.description: Used in QR codes and links, for example R12.

fields.label: Languages
fields.description: Language codes, comma separated, for example hi,en.

fields.label: May take WhatsApp calls
fields.description: This person's browser rings when a customer calls a number of this team (Waba Settings > WhatsApp calls must be on).

fields.label: May place WhatsApp calls
fields.description: Shows the Call button in the chat for this person. Each customer must have allowed calls first, and outgoing calls are billed per minute.
